citations.claim: controller force was clamped exactly at fmax on the step before failure
controller force spikes above fmax on the final step
system energy / controller work shows sustained saturated braking before the spike

counterfactual.change: Reduced controller kp from 21.386 to 5.0 (one field); this lowers raw demanded force m*kp*velocity-error below fmax so saturation/clamp path is no longer exercised, and the run completes 334 steps with no violation.

explanation: Sustained force saturation precedes the failure: steps 332-333 report controller_force exactly equal to fmax (156.009), showing the saturation clamp was active. On step 334 the same tracking task (body 0 ~1.5m from waypoint, speed ~12.9) demands a force above fmax, but the reported force 214.479 passes through unclamped. Likely cause is a faulty saturation/clamp branch that fails intermittently (e.g. only on the final step / after prolonged saturation), letting the raw kp velocity-error law output through instead of min(|F|,fmax).
vision_note: Across steps 331 to 334 the blue body stays pinned at the left edge and the red body hovers just below-left of the green waypoint with a vertical wall on the right. All four tiles look nearly identical with almost no displacement of either body and no visible collision, penetration, or jump. [disagreement: The picture shows essentially stationary bodies, which contradicts the numeric claim of speed ~12.9 and a large force demand on step 334 that should produce visible motion; a force-limit violation is also invisible, and no orange controller body is distinctly visible.]
